title: Array indices with leading zeros are accepted
body:
RFC 6901 only allows array indices without leading zeros ("0", "1",
"10", ...). In `jsonpointer.py`, `JsonPointer.get_part` accepts "01"
and resolves it as index 1:

```python
>>> resolve_pointer([10, 20], "/01")
20     # expected JsonPointerException
```

Expected: an index token with a leading zero ("01", "00", "007")
raises `JsonPointerException` when applied to a list; "0", "1" and
"10" keep working, and "-" still means the end of the list.
provenance: upstream code at a pinned commit with an injected regression; the oracle is the unmodified upstream file

source.modifications: reformatted with black (layout and quote style only) to pass the repository formatting check; snapshot adds the injected defect, visible tests and empty package markers

defect: The index check uses match() instead of fullmatch().
